summary.headline: Interrogation About Acquiring a Kingdom
summary.text: Astrological interrogation rules explain how the Moon’s bodily conjunctions with Venus and Mars indicate rumor, loss, and dissolution, and how angularity strengthens or hastens good and bad outcomes. Chapter VIII discusses determining whether an interrogator will acquire and preside over a kingdom, including how to time absolute and time-specific questions.
